purpose: Prospective full original point q0 acoustic solver with SAME Cartesian 8point trilinear interpolation family as upstream PFFDTD, plus variational physical cut-domain Q1 bilinear consistent mass / Neumann stiffness exactly integrated over true 56m3 planar sloped roof. Tests numerical consistency of original source+receiver with Q1 spatial trial/test space, avoiding grid-dependent triangular P1 simplex selection. All modes retained including true cutcell boundary ghost supports; no damp/cut/fitted q0.

original.original_true_q0: in_sigs[:,0] at original 8 Cartesian nodes, q[n>0]=0, original native source total strength

new_operator.x: exact previous physical x native nodes + physical endpoints P1 exact 1D Galerkin consistent mass and standard stiffness; all 8 original x source node positions retained
new_operator.yz: original native Cartesian y,z NODE coordinates define standard bilinear Q1 rectangular cell basis over all Cartesian grid cells whose intersection with true physical trapezoid is nonempty; exterior Cartesian nodes with nonzero physical basis support kept as ghost DOFs; zero-support DOFs only are not included
new_operator.true_exact_domain: clip each original native Cartesian rectangle exactly to y0,y4,z0 and sloped roof; triangulate only the clipped polygon for integration, no replacement of Q1 basis or element deletion
new_operator.element_mass: integrate all products N_iN_j of original rectangle Q1 basis on physically clipped rectangle; 6-point positive Dunavant triangle rule exact polynomial total degree 4; full consistent offdiagonal mass
new_operator.element_stiffness: integrate c² grad N_i·grad N_j over same clipped polygons; exact degree2 via same quadrature, natural physical Neumann roof/walls
new_operator.full_3D_operators: M=Mx tensor MyzQ1; K=Kx tensor MyzQ1 + Mx tensor KyzQ1. No artificial sliver spectral stabilizer
new_operator.source_receiver: use exact original native HDF5 8node source and receiver indices/weights as Q1 weak Dirac and nodal point observer. Same original physically fixed source and receiver (no revised interpolation)
new_operator.q0_integrator: same native beta=1/4 Newmark original q0, all sampled 250ms full original pressure 40/80Hz signed, all eigmodes
